title: Teaching a Parent to Use a Smartphone
paragraphs: When his father received his first smartphone as a birthday gift, Adnan quickly realized that basic tasks like sending a text message needed to be explained slowly, step by step, several times.
His father, feeling embarrassed about needing so much help, joked that he had managed complex machinery at work for thirty years but somehow could not manage a simple phone screen.
Adnan patiently created a written guide with large, simple steps for the tasks his father used most often, like calling family members and checking the weather each morning.
Within a month, his father was confidently sending voice messages and photos to the family group chat, proudly showing off skills that had seemed impossible to him just weeks earlier.
